statement.p: Determine whether {\bf r}_1 and {\bf r}_2 collide or intersect:

The two paths
do not collide
collide

The two paths
do not intersect
intersect

static.solution:
t such that:
\left\lt t,t^2,t^3 \right> = \left\lt 5t+1, 36t^{2},216 \right>
Equating corresponding components we obtain the following equations:
t=5t+1
t^2=36t^{2}
t^3=216
The second equation implies that t=0, but this value does not satisfy the other equations. Therefore, the equations have no solution, which means that the paths do not collide.
The two paths intersect if there exist values of t and s such that:
\left\lt s,s^2,s^3 \right> = \left\lt 5t+1, 36t^{2},216 \right>
Or equivalently:
s=5t+1
s^2=36t^{2}
s^3=216
The second equation implies that s=\pm 6 t, and the third equation implies s=6. Hence t=\pm 1
We can see that one of the solutions satisfies the first equation, hence the two paths intersect.
